Natural Disasters, Local Bank Market Share, and Economic Recovery
abstract: Bank credit is a critical source of funding following a natural disaster. We test whether there are differences in post-disaster credit allocation and regional redevelopment based on the type of existing banking institutions at the time of a natural disaster. We instrument for the composition of local and national banking institutions using bank deregulation. We find less new credit and slower economic recovery in regions with a higher concentration of local banking. The supply of credit and the impact of local banks are overestimated when we fail to account for the endogenous development of banking institutions.
abstract_zh: 银行信贷是自然灾害后的关键资金来源。我们检验灾害发生时既有银行机构的类型是否会导致灾后信贷配置和区域重建存在差异。我们以银行放松管制作为本地与全国银行机构构成的工具变量。研究发现，本地银行业集中度较高的地区，新增信贷较少，经济复苏也较慢。若不考虑银行机构的内生发展，信贷供给量以及本地银行的影响都会被高估。

Household Finance after a Natural Disaster: The Case of Hurricane Katrina
abstract: Little is known about how affected residents are able to cope with the financial shock of a natural disaster. This paper investigates the impact of flooding on household finance. Spikes in credit card borrowing and overall delinquency rates for the most flooded residents are modest in size and short-lived. Greater flooding results in larger reductions in total debt. Lower debt levels are driven by homeowners using flood insurance to repay their mortgages rather than to rebuild. Mortgage reductions are larger in areas where reconstruction costs exceeded pre-Katrina home values and where mortgages were likely to be originated by nonlocal lenders. (JEL D14, G21, G22, Q54)
abstract_zh: 关于受灾居民如何应对自然灾害带来的财务冲击，人们知之甚少。本文考察洪水对家庭财务的影响。受灾最严重居民的信用卡借贷激增和总体拖欠率上升幅度较小，且持续时间较短。洪水越严重，居民的总债务减少幅度越大。债务水平下降的原因在于，业主将洪水保险理赔款用于偿还抵押贷款，而非用于重建。在重建成本超过卡特里娜飓风前房屋价值的地区，以及抵押贷款可能由非本地贷款机构发放的地区，抵押贷款的减少幅度更大。（JEL D14, G21, G22, Q54）
